companyName.title: Company or facility name
companyName.description: Facility or company name to search ("exxon", "tyson foods"). Partial match. Combine with a state to narrow it.

state.title: State
state.description: Two-letter state code ("TX", "CA"). Use alone to sweep a whole state's regulated facilities, or with a company name.

naicsCode.title: Industry (NAICS code)
naicsCode.description: Limit to an industry by NAICS code prefix ("324" = petroleum, "3116" = meat processing). Optional.

violatorsOnly.title: Only facilities currently in violation
violatorsOnly.description: Return only facilities whose current compliance status shows a violation or significant non-compliance. The highest-signal filter.

activeOnly.title: Only active facilities
activeOnly.description: Exclude facilities EPA has flagged inactive.
